data.gender_notes: Mariamne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek Mariamne, meaning 'Mary's bitter one'. In the New Testament, Mariamne is the name of the wife of Herod Antipas, who was beheaded for her alleged infidelity with John the Baptist. The name Mariamne carries the meaning “Mary's bitter one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mariamne usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's bitter one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
